about: The 5 steps every idea goes through, one idea after another (owner 2026-10-22); an idea stops at the first failed gate and the next starts at once. The one queue is docs/ideas/queue.jsonl (new -> testing -> tester -> hydra/funded/both, or rejected). 'agent' is the role file in .claude/agents/ or the prompt in tools/autopilot/prompts/. The dashboard (python tools/dashboard.py) reads this file.

steps.name: Find the next idea
steps.detail: Rotates four sources: prebuilt edges (GitHub, MQL5 CodeBase, Quantpedia, QuantConnect) to improve, research papers read in full, ML models and DRL models. Checks each against the rejected families and queues it in docs/ideas/queue.jsonl; simple rules go to docs/ideas/specs/ for idea_engine.py. Also fetches data the queue asks for.

steps.name: Build and test in Python with the gates
steps.detail: Builds the idea (or the improved prebuilt edge) in research/ on all the data before the holdout (2025-10-13), at 1x, 1.5x and 2x costs, and runs tools/gates.py: Sharpe >= 0.5 in both halves, >= 0.3 at 1.5x costs, DSR >= 0.90, correlation <= 0.20 with the book and <= 0.30 with each leg, book Sharpe +0.03 and P(5x) up. A FAIL is logged and the next idea starts; a PASS gets a standalone MQL5 EA compiled to 0/0 and a queued tester job.

steps.name: Strategy Tester to 2025-09-30
steps.detail: tools/autopilot/tester_step.py runs the queued job in C:\MetaTrader 5 - Tester on FTMO's real ticks and compares it with the Python figures; the tester agent only starts when the script asks for help.

steps.name: Integrate switched off
steps.detail: The leg goes into the EA it suits best, AurumHydra (5x goal), AurumFunded (prop rules) or both, as an input that is off by default, compiled to 0/0; a leg on vs off tester run shows what it adds.

steps.name: Judge and review
steps.detail: The judge reads the tester results against the Python figures, has the reviewer check the EA change with a fresh context, and records the verdict on the queue item (hydra, funded, both or rejected). It also handles demo orders and ALERTs; the monitor checks the FTMO demo nightly. Nothing goes live without the owner.
